integrity: Finite exact-rational tests corroborate a self-contained martingale argument; neither mathematical originality nor correctness has received independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact noncritical fixation requires biregularity; at product balance arbitrary connected bipartite graphs are covered. Uniform-bias and balanced equal-intensity specializations were previously known. Rates must be strictly positive; no claims for spatially varying within-part rates, mutations, synchronous dynamics, or unverified priority.
title: Exact fixation with opposing community biases on bipartite networks
